objective: Explain why the live Console origin answers 502 on the platform administrator's own refund policy list once the table holds a row, while the sibling price and retention policy lists answer 200 in the same administrator session.

defect.statement: The stored row carries the contract's own hyphenated spelling (CreateRefundPolicyVersion writes the literal "workspace-delete-refund-v1"), while the generated enum spells its members with underscores (REFUND_POLICY_VERSION_ALGORITHM_ENUM_WORKSPACE_DELETE_REFUND_V1). Because the separator is never normalized, the lookup misses, the missing key on a Go map yields the zero value, and the field silently becomes REFUND_POLICY_VERSION_ALGORITHM_ENUM_UNSPECIFIED.
whyTheSilentFallbackBecomesA502: api.RefundPolicyVersionAlgorithmEnum declares only UNSPECIFIED = 0 and WORKSPACE_DELETE_REFUND_V1 = 1, so the unspecified member has no public spelling
the public contract marks RefundPolicyVersion.algorithm as required (packages/contracts/go/publicjson/shape_generated.go)

publicjson.Marshal in packages/contracts/go/publicjson/codec.go refuses a required property whose wire value has no published text and returns "required property RefundPolicyVersion.algorithm has no public value for REFUND_POLICY_VERSION_ALGORITHM_ENUM_UNSPECIFIED"

the Admin catalog list route (apps/console-bff/internal/httpapi/catalog.go) always encodes its owner answer through that codec, so it maps the encoder failure to HTTP 502 with the declared publisher error envelope

existingCorrectPatternInTheSameFile.statement: the same file already normalizes the separator for the price policy's plan-change member, so the refund path is a missing step in an in-repo pattern rather than a missing convention

localReproduction.how: a scratch Go test in a detached worktree at product SHA bc99e765 called publicjson.Marshal on the page the list builds with the mapped-unspecified member
localReproduction.observed: err = "required property RefundPolicyVersion.algorithm has no public value for REFUND_POLICY_VERSION_ALGORITHM_ENUM_UNSPECIFIED", raw = empty
localReproduction.control: the same message with Algorithm set to WORKSPACE_DELETE_REFUND_V1 marshals cleanly and emits "algorithm":"workspace-delete-refund-v1"
localReproduction.lookupProbe: the mapping probe logged "REFUND_POLICY_VERSION_ALGORITHM_ENUM_WORKSPACE-DELETE-REFUND-V1" -> ok=false value=0 and "REFUND_POLICY_VERSION_ALGORITHM_ENUM_WORKSPACE_DELETE_REFUND_V1" -> ok=true value=1

runs 37815274349, 37816285206, 37838710197, 37842454166 and 37845816295: the list answered 502 before any write, with the price and retention lists at 200 in the same sessions

liveRunSequence.launchReach: the customer quote and Workspace create path reads refundPolicyVersionId and the frozen refundTerms string, never the nested RefundPolicyVersion.algorithm, so this defect does not block a customer launch; it blocks the administrator list readback

openTransportObservation.statement: the live 502 body's own envelope was recorded from the Instance lane as a JSON object publishing type, title, status and detail with the route's own no-store directive, which is not a shape any revision in this repository's history produces on that route; the defect above is established independently of the body's envelope

requiredRepair.statement: normalize the stored separator before the enum-name lookup in scanRefundPolicy, matching planChangePolicyVersionEnum in the same file, and add the focused test that would have caught it (a list read over a stored hyphenated algorithm)
requiredRepair.whyNoDataMigration: the stored value is the contract's own spelling and remains correct; only the reader's mapping is wrong
